subject: Competitive evidence request + seat-pack decision for Neoteric Systems
messages:
From: Danielle Cruz <danielle@neoteric.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@neoteric.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NeoEdge competitor offer + request for formal counter

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement pushed back with a competing offer from NeoEdge and they asked us to get a firm counter from Redwood with the following specifics:

- Price: list + proposed discount schedule for first 12 months (committed seats + overage rate)
- Packaging: a comparison of your seat-pack vs their per-token/commit model
- Evidence: any performance/cost benchmarks and an ops onboarding credit to close the gap

I attached the competitor PDF and a spreadsheet with the numbers they shared. Can you send over what you can to help us with our evaluation? We need something official to present to legal next week.

Appreciate it,
Danielle Cruz
Head of Platform Partnerships
Neoteric Systems

[Attachment: NeoEdge_offer_20260717.pdf (pdf)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: NeoEdge competitor offer + request for formal counter

Looping you both in — see Neoteric's ask below and attached competitor files. Quick thoughts:

- They want an official counter ASAP (legal review next Tue).
- We should offer a short-term seat-pack pilot discount + a 3-month onboarding credit rather than a permanent list price change. Keeps long-term ARPU intact.
- Need a crisp one-page comparison (seat-pack vs per-token) with sample cost at their observed monthly token volumes.

Irene — can you generate a cost comparison and call out where Redwood's batching/caching reduces effective token spend?
Stephanie — can you craft a pilot credit structure (months, $ credit, SLA language) and a suggested commercial fallback (e.g., 10% off list or extended onboarding for enterprise legal)?

Goal: provide Neoteric a transparent, evidence-backed counter that shows technical and economic defensibility.

—Michael
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

[Forwarded attachment: NeoEdge_offer_20260717.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NeoEdge competitor offer + request for formal counter

Attached: "NeoEdge_comparison_table.xlsx" — I populated a side-by-side for their quoted volumes (avg 5M tokens/month; peak 12M). Key highlights I pulled:

- Effective token cost: Redwood seat-pack (with reasonable batching & prefix caching) comes in ~22% cheaper vs NeoEdge per-token after our recommended config. I included assumptions tab (batch size distribution, cache hit 18%).
- Latency: our 95th percentile is 120–180ms for their median sequence length; NeoEdge lists 250–400ms in the PDF. Lower latency reduces perceived UX cost for their product team.
- Migration effort: our integration guide shows 1-week dev integration for core endpoints, 2 weeks for full KV cache/LLM-cache tuning; NeoEdge lists 4–6 weeks for operational parity.

Notes / asks:
- Would like confirmation from Product on using the 18% cache-hit assumption; if we use 12% the delta shrinks to ~12% savings.
- Also flagged a soft ROI chart for them (6 month payback if they commit to 12 months).

I attached the spreadsheet and a one-pager summary paragraph at the top.

Irene
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: NeoEdge_comparison_table.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NeoEdge competitor offer + request for formal counter

Draft pilot credit + commercial options below (short-list for negotiation):

Option A — Pilot Pack (recommended):
- 3-month pilot with 50% off seat-pack price for up to 8 seats + $40k onboarding credit applied to first invoice.
- If they convert to 12‑month commit within 30 days of pilot end, onboarding credit converts into implementation services credits.
- No change to standard SLA; add one-week expedited onboarding slot.

Option B — Price Match Safeguard (limited-time):
- Match NeoEdge headline discount (they offered 18% off list for year 1) for 12 months for up to committed 10 seats, with a 6-month early-termination fee to protect revenue.

Option C — Token-blend fallback:
- Offer a hybrid: base seat-pack covering X tokens/month, overage priced at a blended per-token rate that yields approximately 10–12% advantage vs NeoEdge at their stated volume.

Recommended: propose Option A + Option C as fallback. Pilot keeps us from setting a lower list precedent and gives Neoteric time to validate latency/cost in production.

I can draft the formal commercial language and a short one-page contemplative counter. Want me to send to Danielle directly or run through you first, Michael?

—Stephanie
Director, Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Cruz <danielle@neoteric.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@neoteric.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood counter to NeoEdge offer — summary + next steps

Danielle — thanks for sharing the NeoEdge materials. Attached is a concise one-page counter plus the comparison workbook (summary on page 1). High level:

- Commercial: we recommend a 3-month Pilot Pack (Option A) — 50% off seat-pack for up to 8 seats plus a $40k onboarding credit. If Neoteric converts to a 12-month commit within 30 days of pilot completion we convert credit to implementation services credit.
- Technical/economic evidence: workbook shows effective token-cost delta at their stated volumes, plus latency percentiles and migration timeline. We highlighted conservative cache-hit assumptions so the savings are defensible.
- Ops: we offer a prioritized onboarding window and a single point of contact from Solutions to guarantee cutover and KV caching tuning.

If that sounds reasonable I can have Legal ingest the pilot terms (short form amendment) and we can route a final one-pager to your legal/procurement team by EOD Monday. If you prefer a price-match instead, we can draft Option B as a fallback but would need a 6-month early-termination protection clause to proceed.

Next steps: please confirm preferred path (Pilot vs Price Match) and whether Procurement wants the draft commercial language in advance of legal review.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_Neoteric_counter_20260720.pdf (pdf)]
